text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — Ticara asked for a POC perf run. Goal: 3k sustained QPS with ~20% short microbursts (5–10s). They want p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput heatmap, and an estimate for committed vs on-demand pricing. Can we draft a run plan + quote by EOD tomorrow?

Priya Kapoor: Got it. Quick Qs for Ticara — is the 3k QPS all text-generation (chat/completions) or mix with embeddings/reranking? Also which model family are they validating (open LLaMA variant or Llama2-style)? Pricing differs a lot.

Alex Chen: Mostly chat/generation with occasional rerank calls (maybe 10% embeddings). They said "mistral-deriv" family in their NDA but not specific. Latency SLO target is <=200ms p95 for short prompts (~120 tokens).

Jordan Smith: Thanks. Proposed test profile: ramp 0 -> 3k over 15m, hold 30m steady, then 3x microburst pattern: 10s at +50% qps every 5m during hold. Capture cold-start phase (first 2m) and steady-state. Measure p50/p95/p99, tail latency CDF, and token/sec. Also capture GPU utilization and host-level OOM spikes.

Jordan Smith: Example load command (we'll run from dedicated runner against hosted endpoint):

```
# vegeta-style poisson attack (pseudo)
loadtest --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  --rate 3000 --duration 00:45:00 --burst-pattern "10s:+50% every 5m" \n  --concurrency 200 --body-file sample_prompts.json \  --headers 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

Marta Ruiz: Ops notes: for a clean signal we should pin the model version and disable background warmups. If they want strict <=200ms p95 we'll need either a small Dedicated pool (2-4 GPUs depending on model size) or aggressive KV prefix caching + quantization. Hosted on-demand will have noisy neighbors for microbursts.

Marta Ruiz: Also need Ticara to confirm encryption needs (KMS/HSM) — if they require HSM for keys we may need Private deployment for the POC which adds lead time.

Ravi Patel: Pricing ask — can you give me two numbers: 1) 1-month committed Dedicated estimate (including reserved pool + burst credits) and 2) best-effort hosted on-demand estimate for their test profile. I can present both to procurement.

Priya Kapoor: For the quote I'll need expected token mix (prompt vs completion tokens), avg tokens per request, and % of requests that hit rerank/embedding. Alex can you confirm?

Alex Chen: Pinged the buyer for token mix, they said ~60 prompt / 120 completion on avg, so ~180 tokens per request. Embedding/rerank ~10% of requests, smaller token sizes.

Jordan Smith: With 3k req/s * 180 tokens ≈ 540k tokens/s. Rough back-of-envelope GPU sizing: if this is an LLaMA-deriv 30B FP16, we'd need ~3-4 A100-equivalent for steady state with KV cache + batching; quantized 4-bit could drop it to 2-3. I'll run a more precise sim and post numbers.

Marta Ruiz: Runbook items I'll own: reserve Dedicated pool on stage, configure autoscale min=2 max=6, set buffer for burst handling, enable prefix KV cache, disable background warmup. Need final model binary name and container.

eng-runner-bot: loadtest scheduled: ticara-poc-run-1812350200 (runner: perf-6, plan: ramp->steady->bursts).

Priya Kapoor: Security Qs: Ticara submitted a short questionnaire. They asked about data residency and KMS. If they require BYOK with HSM, we escalate to Private. Can Eng/Security confirm checklist items to answer?

Marta Ruiz: I can answer the checklist for hosted/dedicated: KMS integration (customer-managed key) yes for Dedicated via our KMS proxy; HSM-backed BYOK requires Private. Also we can provide audit logs and SSO. I'll draft answers now.

Ravi Patel: For the committed quote, procurement prefers a 3-month reserved commitment number. Can we do 1-month and 3-month buckets in the quote? Also include burst credits pricing and overage rates.

Jordan Smith: Action for me: run a quick sim with our perf model harness tonight to estimate GPU-seconds and throughput per-GPU, post results before 10:30am tomorrow.

Alex Chen: I'll schedule a 30min sync with Ticara and include Ravi + Priya + Jordan + Marta for tomorrow 9am PT. I'll also attach sample prompts and their short questionnaire.

Priya Kapoor: Thanks — once Jordan posts the GPU sizing I'll draft the two-tier quote and a short explainer: "why Dedicated helps with microbursts". Ravi will review before sending. :+1:

Ops Oncall: FYI — if the dedicated pool goes to autoscale=6 during bursts please watch tail latencies; set alert threshold p95 > 350ms.

Alex Chen: Summary / next steps:
- Jordan: perf sim + GPU sizing (deliver by 10:30am)
- Marta: reserve stage Dedicated pool & draft security answers (EOD)
- Priya/Ravi: prepare 1-month & 3-month committed quotes + hosted on-demand estimate (after Jordan numbers)
- Alex: sync with Ticara tomorrow 9am PT, will attach token-mix + questionnaire.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — any blockers?

Priya Kapoor: No blockers from sales side.

Marta Ruiz: None.

Jordan Smith: None, starting the sim now.

eng-runner-bot: run started: ticara-sim-1812350300 (ETA ~20m)

Alex Chen: Great — will follow up after sim. :rocket:
